Simulate Lactation Curves

Source: R/lactation.R
simulate_lactation.Rd

Generates cow-level Wood's lactation curve parameters and predicted daily milk yield for each cow's current days in milk. This is the biological engine underlying simulate_milk().

Usage

simulate_lactation(herd, seed = NULL)

Arguments

herd

A tibble produced by simulate_herd().

seed

Integer. Random seed for reproducibility. Default is NULL.

Value

The input tibble with additional columns: wood_a, wood_b, wood_c, peak_dim, peak_yield, predicted_yield.

Details

Wood's model: Y = a * DIM^b * exp(-c * DIM)

  • wood_a — scale parameter (drives overall yield level)

  • wood_b — inclining slope (time to peak)

  • wood_c — declining slope (persistency)

  • peak_dim — predicted day of peak yield = b / c

  • peak_yield — predicted peak yield in kg

Breed and lactation adjustments are applied to wood_a. Individual cow-level random effects are added to all three parameters.

Examples

herd <- simulate_herd(100, seed = 1)
lact <- simulate_lactation(herd, seed = 1)
